Intro_description: Software Engineer specialized in frontend development, and I love building web applications that work well and feel good to use. I work mainly with React, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, thinking through each project from component architecture down to the details of performance, authentication, and security. I like understanding the full picture: beyond frontend, I'm comfortable integrating APIs, working with Node.js, SQL databases, cloud services, and even legacy systems when needed. I'm methodical, care about code quality, and enjoy working as part of agile, cross-functional teams. Contact me and let's build something great together!
